about: Evaluation queries for the Linguistics matcher. 30 statement-style English queries, 6 short keyword queries, 4 Chinese queries. Written separately from pipeline/probes.json (calibration) so the test set is not tuned on. Relevance judgments go in judgments.json (graded 0-3, see RUBRIC.md).

queries.text: I want to study the syntax of wh-questions and island effects in Mandarin Chinese, combining theoretical analysis with acceptability judgment experiments.
My interest is in how listeners adapt to unfamiliar accents, using perceptual learning experiments and computational models of speech perception.
I study the acoustics and phonology of tone sandhi in Southern Min and Wu Chinese dialects, based on fieldwork recordings.
I am interested in the semantics of evidentiality and modality in Quechua, using field elicitation with native speakers.
My research examines how heritage speakers of Korean in the United States use honorifics, combining sociolinguistic interviews and experimental tasks.
I want to study how children learn verb meanings from syntactic context (syntactic bootstrapping), using preferential looking experiments with toddlers.
I study the neural basis of reading and dyslexia in Chinese and English using EEG and fMRI.
I am interested in using transformer language models to test theories of syntax, such as whether models learn hierarchical structure from child-directed speech.
My research is on Arabic diglossia and code-switching between dialects and Modern Standard Arabic on social media.
I want to document an endangered Austronesian language in Taiwan and work with the community on revitalization materials.
I study vowel shifts and sound change in progress in California English, using sociophonetic analysis of a large interview corpus.
My interest is in second language pronunciation: how adult Spanish learners of English acquire vowel contrasts and whether perceptual training helps.
I study the pragmatics of politeness and indirect requests in Japanese workplace interaction, using conversation analysis.
I want to work on morphological typology: the distribution of polysynthesis across the world's languages and its historical sources.
My research is on speech production in children with developmental language disorder and how morphosyntactic deficits show up in narratives.
I am interested in sign language phonology and the grammar of space in American Sign Language.
I study language contact in the Andes between Spanish and Quechua, especially changes in word order and evidential marking in Andean Spanish.
I want to build speech recognition for Indigenous languages of the Americas with very little data, using self-supervised speech models.
My research uses eye-tracking during reading to study how readers predict upcoming words and how surprisal affects reading times.
I am interested in formal semantics: the meaning of plurals, mass nouns and distributivity, and how they vary across languages.
I study language ideologies about Mandarin and minority languages in China, and how language policy affects schools in ethnic minority regions.
My research is on historical Chinese phonology and the reconstruction of Middle and Old Chinese.
I want to study the prosody of focus and how intonation interacts with lexical tone in Cantonese, using production and perception experiments.
I study bilingual language control and cross-language interference in Spanish-English bilinguals, using reaction time experiments and EEG.
My research is in applied linguistics: writing development of international students in English for academic purposes, using learner corpora.
I am interested in the phonetics of glottalization and voice quality, using laryngography and acoustic analysis.
I study creole languages of West Africa and the Caribbean and whether creoles share structural features.
I want to investigate how large language models handle pragmatic inference, such as implicature and presupposition, compared with humans.
My research is on aphasia rehabilitation and how bilingual patients recover each of their languages after stroke.
I study the role of gesture in child language development and how gesture predicts later vocabulary growth.

研究儿童如何习得汉语的量词和句法结构，用纵向语料分析。
